description: Get monthly search volume, CPC, competition and similar keywords for up to 25 keywords in one country at once. Prefer this over repeated lookup_keyword calls when comparing or prioritizing a keyword list.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code for the market. Default "us".

name: lookup_keywords

failed.description: Keywords whose lookup failed upstream; retry later

cpc.description: Average cost per click in USD

found.description: False when there is no data for this keyword

overlap.description: How many top-ranking pages the two keywords share

updated_at.description: When this data was last refreshed (ISO 8601)

skipped.description: Keywords not looked up because a quota or daily new-keyword limit ran out

title: Look up search volume for many keywords
